200 Returned if Tenable One successfully retrieved the data for the specified exposure view card.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The unique ID of the exposure view card.
string
The name of the exposure view card.
string
Enum: "GLOBAL"
"CATEGORY"
"EXPOSURE"
"CUSTOM"
sla_efficiency_start_date
sla_efficiency_end_date
sla_breakdown_filter
include_trend_events
id
name
card_type
The type of exposure view card. Global cards are Tenable-
provided cards. Custom cards are user-created cards.
boolean
Indicates whether or not the exposure view card is a
Tenable-provided global card ( true ) or a user-created
custom card ( false ).
object
An object containing Cyber Exposure Scores (CES) per
exposure, per tag, and total.
Array of objects
An array of Cyber Exposure Score (CES) values along with
their timestamps.
string <date-time>
A timestamp in ISO 8601 format indicating the date and
time when the exposure view card was created.
string <date-time>
A timestamp in ISO 8601 format indicating the date and
time when the exposure view card was last updated.
integer
The number of tags associated with the exposure view
card.
Array of strings
The exposure class is determined by the sensor that
assessed the asset or detected the finding. For more
information about exposure classes, see Scoring (Beta).
Array of strings
The sources that supply data for the card.
string <date-time>
A timestamp in ISO 8601 format indicating the date and
time when the data for the exposure view card was last
updated.
object
Metrics, breakdowns, and efficiency data for each exposure
class. Exposure classes include VM , WAS , CLOUD , OT ,
IDENTITY , and ALL . For each exposure class, score
benchmarks, asset risk breakdowns, score trend metrics,
SLA efficiency, and SLA breakdowns are included.

— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
401 Returned if the API keys specified in your request are invalid.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to retrieve the specified exposure view card.
404 Returned if Tenable One could not find the specified exposure view card.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable One.
